name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
title: Info Edge (India) Ltd - 532777 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Naukri billings up ~17% (about 15% normalised) with pricing and new AI products carrying growth, but Shiksha billings fell 23% and 99acres is only near break-even; no capacity lens applies to this asset-light platform.

summary.headline: Info Edge Q1 FY27: standalone billings up over 14% and recruitment billings up 17%, with underlying recruitment billings growth at about 15%.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue rose 12% YoY to Rs.824 crores and operating profit rose 33% to Rs.334 crores, with cash from operations up 25% to Rs.225 crores. Naukri recruitment billings grew 17%, which management says is about 15% after adjusting for renewal timing, with revenue up 13% and a 58% operating PBT margin. 99acres billings grew 17% and its operating PBT loss narrowed to about Rs.2 crores, near break-even. Shiksha billings fell 23% on AI-driven search traffic loss, and matchmaking grew billings 20% and was near break-even.

financial_highlights.metric: Cash balance at end of Q1

segments.name: Naukri recruitment
segments.commentary: Billings up over 17% (about 15% normalised), revenue up 13%, operating PBT margin 58%. Tech/IT/BPM billings +15%, GCCs +31%, other sectors +12%, recruitment consultants +1%.

segments.name: Naukri Jobseeker (Naukri 360)
segments.commentary: Billings up over 35%, PBT margin 63%. Paid subscribers rose from 1.3% to 2.6% of MAU over six quarters.

segments.name: NaukriGulf
segments.commentary: Grew 12%, below the roughly 20% pre-geopolitical trajectory; operating margin above 35%.

segments.name: 99acres
segments.commentary: Billings and revenue both up about 17%; operating PBT loss of about Rs.2 crores versus Rs.17 crores underlying loss in Q4 FY26. Web timeshare 49%, app 55%, iOS 69%.

segments.name: Shiksha
segments.commentary: Billings down 23% and revenue down 12% as reduced Google referral traffic hit client delivery; US and Canada study-abroad softer.

segments.name: Matchmaking (Jeevansathi, Aisle)
segments.commentary: Portfolio billings up 20%; Aisle +44%, Jeevansathi +14%; near break-even operating PBT; more than 45% profile share in Hindi-speaking markets.

segments.name: Job Hai
segments.commentary: Revenue roughly doubled on a small base; about Rs.15 crores revenue last year, burn near Rs.50 crores a year.

guidance_outlook: Management said it is not guiding on billing growth; it is unsure whether volume growth can sustain 10% or 15%, but is more confident on new products than six months ago.
Margin expansion depends on topline growth in the teens; if topline grows 8-10%, margins will be hard to improve.
Heavy AI investment will continue, so margins are not expected to expand from AI monetisation alone.
99acres aims to become cash-generative during FY27 and to grow revenue 18-20% a year with cost control; ultimate goal of 30% margin.
Job Hai aims to more than double revenue this year, reach 18 cities in coming months, and could reach Rs.100 crores in two to three years.
Headcount is down YoY; management expects to resume hiring once the business grows in the teens.
capex_capacity: AI-Rex live across more than 4,000 enterprise customers and recruitment firms by end-June, with over 10% converted to paid; free trial rolled out to 10,000 customers in Q2.
Talent Pulse has more than 600 paid customers; AI-Rex and Talent Pulse to be scaled to several thousand more customers over the next few quarters.
Coding Ninjas acquisition completed; short-form upskilling courses priced at Rs.5,000-7,000 being tested.
Over 150 people in GenAI and machine learning; AI efficiencies of 15-20% in some functions.
99Shorts (new project listings) launched in NCR, with plans to expand to more cities; new project segment estimated at over Rs.5,000 crores.
Naukri database of about 118 million resumes, with over 25,000 new profiles added daily.
demand_pricing: Growth split per management: about one-third from volume and renewals, about one-third from price increases, and about one-third from new offerings (AI-Rex, Talent Pulse, employer branding); customer-count growth is a small subset.
AI-Rex priced per mandate at Rs.3,500 for companies and Rs.2,500 for consultants (launch prices); sold to over 400 clients in Q1 and about 300 more in July.
Recruitment consultants, about a quarter of revenue, grew only 1%; management attributes this to clients insourcing in a slow market.
99acres: primary about 45-47% of revenue, secondary about equal, owners 7-10%; NCR is the largest market and has been affected by sales-team restructuring.
Management says the JobSpeak index measures volume only, which does not capture premiumisation, pricing and new products.
Competitive pressure easing after Housing.com was acquired by Aurum, which management expects to reduce competitor marketing spend.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 13% revenue growth is from realisation versus customer count, and how much from AI products?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about one-third of revenue growth came from renewals and volume, and about one-third from newer offerings such as AI-Rex and Talent Pulse. Premium CV views are growing over 25% from a small base.

qa_highlights.question: Is the normalised 15% recruitment billings growth adjusted for the favourable Q1 FY26 base?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said normalisation nets out early and deferred renewals each quarter, which captures the prior-year base effect. GCC billings grew 31% reported, with about 2.5% of one-off timing shift from Q4 FY26 deferrals.

qa_highlights.question: Are clients paying separately for AI-Rex, and is there cannibalisation?
qa_highlights.answer: AI-Rex is charged per mandate and sold separately in many cases, by the same sales team plus specialists. Of 4,000 free trials, 400 converted; management says cannibalisation is possible, mainly among consultants who downgraded.

qa_highlights.question: Will 99acres reach 30% margin faster after the Housing acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management hopes so: competitive intensity should fall as Aurum may cut marketing spend. Sales restructuring is mostly behind, and NCR may take one to two more months to normalise.

qa_highlights.question: What is the AI-Rex renewal cycle and how is value measured?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it needs one renewal cycle to confirm success. Customers buy mandate bundles (10, 20 or 30 mandates), and internal dashboards track shortlisting, screening and delivery time.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 99acres billing reconciled against JobSpeak index trends?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the JobSpeak index tracks volume only, while billings also include premiumisation, pricing and new products. Sanjeev Bikhchandani attributed faster billings to sales teams making more and better calls.

risks_watch: Volume growth depends on net hiring; management says mid-tier volume is weak and consultant (about a quarter of revenue) growth is flat.
Shiksha billings down 23% with no near-term recovery expected; AI-driven search changes and weakness in US and Canada study-abroad.
NaukriGulf growth slowed to 12% due to Middle East disruption.
AI-Rex and Talent Pulse have only one renewal cycle of evidence; possible cannibalisation of existing products.
Consultant and mid-market volume trends; watch whether July's AI-Rex sales convert to paid usage.
Job Hai burn of about Rs.50 crores a year, and 99acres NCR sales recovery.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the Naukri product pipeline and 99acres traction, but cautious on volume: management repeatedly said it does not know whether growth will sustain at 10% or 15%. It was candid that Shiksha faces continued pressure and that 99acres monetisation lagged its traffic lead.
key_quotes: This was a better quarter than the ones we saw through FY26.
If you're able to grow topline in the teens, margins should improve. But if for some reason, top line growth comes at 8, 9, 10%, then it'll be hard to improve margins.
AI is also changing how we operate, driving efficiencies of 15-20% across some functions.
We're confident of being able to deliver revenue growth without adding too many people.

adds.what: AI-Rex live across more than 4,000 enterprise customers and recruitment firms; scaling to several thousand more customers over next few quarters
Talent Pulse with 600+ paid customers, scaling to several thousand more over next few quarters
99Shorts new project listings launched in NCR, plans to expand to more cities
Job Hai to reach 18 cities in coming months

growth.why: Management gives no billing growth guidance; it says margins improve only if topline grows in the teens, and 99acres targets 18-20% revenue growth and Job Hai to more than double revenue, backed mainly by AI-Rex/Talent Pulse adoption and pricing, with recruitment consultants only +1% and Shiksha billings -23%.
